title: intent edit refuses the address form its own remedy tells the operator to use
body:
**MEASURED 2026-08-30 by ic against the debug binary, while looking for a door to a work package's body.**

```
intent edit wp ST0064/01 --path
  error: `ST0064/01` is neither an address nor an artefact id
  remedy: name a thread (`ST0000`), an issue (`0042`), or a full address (`intent:///threads/ST0000`)

intent edit st intent:///threads/ST0056 --path      ->  rc=1  error: `intent:` is not a steel thread id
intent edit st intent://ST0056 --path               ->  rc=1  error: `intent:` is not a steel thread id
intent edit wp intent:///threads/ST0064/wps/01 -p   ->  rc=1  error: `intent:` is not a steel thread id
```

**THE REMEDY NAMES A FORM THE VERB CANNOT PARSE, AND IT NAMES IT VERBATIM.** The refusal offers `intent:///threads/ST0000`; handing that exact string back gets a second refusal, and the second one is about `intent:` -- the resolver splits on `/` and reads the URI SCHEME as the steel-thread id. So the operator is told what to type, types it, and is told that what they typed is not a thread.

**A REMEDY IS A PROMISE AND THIS ONE IS UNKEEPABLE.** The estate already rules that a refusal must not name a verb that does not work (`unsettable_kind`'s own comment, and dc wired the `at` door before shipping a refusal that cited it). This is the same rule one layer down: a refusal must not name an ARGUMENT FORM the verb refuses. It is worse than an unhelpful message, because it costs the operator a second attempt and then tells them their compliance was the error.

**IT IS DISTINCT FROM `0149` AND THEY SHARE A CAUSE.** `0149` is `edit` accepting a `kind` and discarding it. This is `edit` naming an address form it cannot resolve. Both are the disambiguator arriving at the door and not surviving the walk to the resolver -- `0149` drops the kind before resolution, this drops the scheme into it.

**AND THERE IS NO DOOR TO A WORK PACKAGE'S BODY AT ALL, WHICH IS HOW THIS WAS FOUND.** `intent wp` is new / start / done / reopen / cancel / reinstate / unstart / rescope / list / show -- nothing writes prose. `WP/NN/info.md` is a GENERATED view whose own footer says `Do not edit this file`, so the file is not the door either. That is the same shape as `0151` (`issues` cannot set a body on an existing issue) and `0090` (`issues add` creates a body no verb can write), one entity over: **three prose fields on three entities, one defect class, and the register has no edit door to any of them.** The live need is ST0064's WP-01 body, which specifies a `GET /_status` endpoint superseded by `AC-01.3` and D56 three days after it was written -- a superseded design that stays legible is a design someone builds from, and it currently cannot be corrected through any surface.

**Closing this requires the remedy and the resolver to agree**, whichever way: either the address form parses, or the refusal stops naming it. Naming a form that does not work is the half that must not survive.
